text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, well, I suppose that's about it. 
Today was just to show my face.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
As long as we get a feel for the 
atmosphere of the battlefield, that's more 
than good enough! Nya-ha-ha-ha!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Though it was just a warm-up, it was a 
run that showed plenty of potential. A 
light round of applause broke out in the 
venue, but――"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
An Umamusume suddenly walked up beside me. 
There was no mistaking it—it was Neo 
Universe.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I stared intently, wondering, 'Is it 
going to disappear again?' ..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seems fine this time. Responsive, too. 
However, what bothers me is...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If it were a graded race, I'd understand. 
You might come watch to study it. However—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I don't understand why they went out of 
their way to watch No Reason's Make Debut 
race. Why come all the way to this 
venue...?

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: They were... a "binary star."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
In other words... it is a "premonition." 
The one who ran was a "DBER"... resembling 
Neo Universe...

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
Eventually, the "planets" will align, and 
the "era" will come. And then—

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
It'll just become full of "ANOI." "My"... 
"my"... "Our"...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I don't quite understand what she's 
saying. However...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Clan of Silence... I felt like I 
caught a glimpse of their mysterious 
nature.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Universe-dono... I see, what we saw 
earlier may have been... a body double.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps there was an Umamusume among the 
runners who was of the same kin, very 
similar to Universe-dono.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
The true Lord Universe will raise his 
banner next year. Furthermore, many allied 
forces will surely emerge.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Truly a "silent invader, quiet as the 
forest," as they say.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
From here on—it seems we'll face a tough 
battle, hm.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing Neo Universe, No Reason also seemed 
to sense the shadow of the Clan of 
Silence.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Now then, Trainer. First things first, a 
war council, a war council!
choice_data_list: No Reason, what happened to this room!?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
This is your Trainer's Office. I took the 
liberty of redecorating it to my liking!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"Though when she caught me, Tazuna-dono 
gave me quite the earful. Nyahahaha!"

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Well, something like this once in a while 
is nice. Make yourself right at home and 
relax~♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...It was remodeled without my 
permission. They might keep changing it 
bit by bit from now on, too..."

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Now, with an eye toward next year's 
showdown with the Silent Clan—first things 
first.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
The question is, how do we mount our 
campaign toward next year's Classic Triple 
Crown?
choice_data_list:
So we're aiming for the Classic Triple 
Crown, huh...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—The Classic Triple Crown. This refers to 
the three most prestigious, quintessential 
GⅠ races representing the Classic tier.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Satsuki Sho, the Japanese Derby, the 
Kikuka Sho. Naturally, No Reason will be 
aiming for those too, but...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"As a stepping stone, if we want to make a 
name among our rivals first, the next goal 
is..."
choice_data_list:
Maybe we should enter one of the Junior 
G1s?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At the end of the year, there are about 
three turf GⅠs held. Running in one of 
them—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Achieving great results and making a name 
for oneself. To walk the royal road with 
pride, that seemed like the best path to 
take.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
"Ooh~, first making a name for myself in a 
GⅠ, huh! I wanna, I wanna! I wanna get 
famous and be fawned over by everyone~."

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: As if that'd ever happen, idiot.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
How shallow your thinking is. You truly 
know nothing of the Warring States period!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Making a name for oneself may seem like a 
good thing at first glance. However—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Looking at it from the other side, that 
makes you a prime target! It means you're 
much easier to take down!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
No matter how strong one is, surrounded by 
enemies, victory cannot be grasped. 
Idealistic nonsense will never conquer the 
world!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Hmm, my idea of the ideal is—this.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Without letting anyone notice, a clean 
strike from behind!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: This is the standard tactic! Nyahaha!
choice_data_list:
I see... So in other words, a "surprise 
attack"?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...I had forgotten. No Reason is an 
Umamusume who will resort to any bizarre 
tactic to achieve her goal.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Let's adapt to her style here. If that's 
the case—
choice_data_list:
Instead of aiming for the big races, how 
about we take the alternate route?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, that sounds fine. You have captured 
my intent perfectly.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Let's quietly build up race experience 
until the Satsuki Sho. And even if you 
desperately feel the urge to run in a 
GⅠ...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
When that time comes, we do it in total 
secrecy! We disguise ourselves as mere 
footsoldiers, yes. And then—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
In the Satsuki Sho, I shall decisively cut 
down Lord Gimlet right out of the gate! 
That shall be the moment everyone learns 
my name.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Nyah-ha-ha-ha!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Behind the beaten path lies a road." I'm 
pretty sure there was a proverb like that.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And so, until next February, she decided 
to stay out of the spotlight and quietly 
build up her experience."
